environment: Apple M4 Pro, arm64, macOS 26.5.1; headless Playwright; local HTTP; no CPU throttling
settings: Quick, 0 ply, deterministic; opening 6-1 in an unlimited Jacoby session, centered cube 1

definitions.coldHintMs: First Hint click to rendered result in a fresh browser context and worker. Browser-level compiled WASM caches may already be warm.
definitions.warmHintMs: Second Hint click to rendered result, same full position and settings; cached analysis.
definitions.feedbackMs: Confirm click to rendered completed move feedback, with initialized engine.

limitations: Illustrative end-to-end samples, not medians or p95. Local network and desktop CPU; not physical-phone or Internet download measurements. Other regression tests were running.
